【原视频简介】
This might be one of the prettiest summer garden plots we’ve ever grown! We planted rows of sweet potatoes with sunflowers in between, and now the sweet potato vines have completely covered the ground while the sunflowers tower above them full of blooms.

In this video, we’ll show you how we planted this combination and talk about why we think these two crops work so well together. The sweet potatoes provide a dense, living ground cover while the sunflowers fill the vertical space above them — giving us a productive garden plot that also happens to look pretty good!

And sweet potatoes aren't the only crop you could use for a planting like this. We’ll talk about some other sprawling summer crops that could work underneath sunflowers, including Seminole pumpkins, watermelons, and even cowpeas.

Our sweet potatoes are also getting closer to harvest, so we’ll take a look underneath all those vines to see what’s happening. We’ll talk about when to harvest sweet potatoes, what we're looking for as harvest approaches, and what we're doing during these final weeks of growth to hopefully get a great crop underground.

Sometimes the best garden combinations aren't complicated. Put a tall crop above, a sprawling crop below, and let each one fill a different part of the garden!

• Using sweet potatoes as living ground cover
